purpose: Test whether the EL aggregate-recurrence versus trajectory-parallelism result and the finite-horizon standing-variation filter persist, disappear, or remain nonstationary over a fixed long horizon.

time_interpretation.note: Long runs are stationary-environment stress tests, not reconstructions of million-year island history.

primary_endpoints: mean far-minus-near inherited investment effect at every checkpoint
history label counts negative/mixed/positive/neutral at every checkpoint

finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.coarse_mean: For both 1600→3200 and 3200→6400, absolute mean-effect change <= 0.01 OR relative change <= 0.05, while mean sign is unchanged.
finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.history_labels: For both 1600→3200 and 3200→6400, >=0.95 of histories retain the same label at deadband 0.01 and absolute mixed-fraction change <=0.05.
finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.stable_if: both coarse_mean and history_labels criteria pass for both late intervals

primary_endpoints: mean absolute investment response at every checkpoint
high-standing / low-standing response ratio at every checkpoint
investment additive-variance proxy at every checkpoint

finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.response_ratio: For both 1600→3200 and 3200→6400, relative change in the high/low response ratio <=0.10.
finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.variance: For each low-standing central-mutation cell, relative VA-proxy change <=0.10 for both 1600→3200 and 3200→6400.
finite_horizon_stationarity_rule.stable_if: response_ratio and all evaluable low-standing variance criteria pass

interpretation_rules.if_backbone_and_labels_stable: Long-horizon stationary-regime support for aggregate recurrence coexisting with trajectory-level nonparallelism, within the declared model.
interpretation_rules.if_mean_stable_labels_converge: Trajectory nonparallelism is primarily transient even if the coarse syndrome-like response persists.
interpretation_rules.if_mean_or_labels_not_stable: Do not call the EL repeatability pattern stationary; report finite-horizon nonstationarity.
interpretation_rules.if_standing_gap_disappears: Standing-variation accessibility filter is transient over the tested long horizon.
interpretation_rules.if_standing_gap_persists_and_stable: Standing-variation accessibility filter persists over the tested stationary-environment horizon.

claim_boundary: 6400 reproductive seasons are not 6400 years for perennial plants and are not a proxy for millions of years.
A constant visitor process over thousands of reproductive seasons is a stress scenario, not a realistic archipelago history.
Stationarity within Model 3 does not imply equilibrium or stability in nature.
No horizon is extended after outcomes are inspected.
No new mutation, speciation, succession, coevolution, or changing source pool is added to make long runs more realistic.
